text:
NEEDS_FIX: YES
Source inventory: a tall glazed A-frame café volume sits over a one-storey base, with a front-left sloped-glass annex, projecting upper terrace, open column-supported seating bay, and exterior stair. A separate flat canopy projects from the greenhouse over the terrace. The current model captures the main massing, but omits that canopy and lacks the source’s timber finish on the broad side wall.
<issue priority="1" view="oblique">problem: The source shows a broad, flat canopy projecting from the greenhouse over the upper terrace; the model has only umbrellas there.
action: Add the projecting canopy and its supports at the source’s approximate height and depth, keeping the existing glazed A-frame roof.</issue>
<issue priority="2" view="right">problem: The large side wall is plain peach in the model, while the source shows a timber-clad material zone.
action: Apply timber cladding to the existing wall without changing its outline or position.</issue>
<keep>Front-left sloped glazed annex reaches the ground in the correct location.</keep>
<keep>Tall glazed A-frame and front gable preserve the source’s main roof silhouette.</keep>
<keep>Projecting upper terrace fascia and open column-supported seating bay match the source’s arrangement.</keep>
